title: How to Buy USDT with MoonPay - Step-by-Step Guide

cues.text: Welcome! In this short video, you'll learn how to buy USDT with MoonPay, and send it straight to the wallet address we gave you.
It only takes a few minutes, and no crypto experience is needed.
First, what is USDT? USDT, also known as Tether, is a stablecoin.
Its value is designed to stay close to one US dollar, so its price doesn't jump up and down like Bitcoin.
That's why it's a simple, fast, and popular way to send payments worldwide.
Before you start, make sure you have four things.
A smartphone or a computer,
a valid ID, such as a passport or a national ID card,
a payment method, like a bank card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or PayPal,
and the wallet address we sent you.
Step one: open your MoonPay account. Go to moonpay.com, or download the official MoonPay app.
Tap Sign up, and enter your email address.
Then enter the code that MoonPay sends to your email.
Step two: verify your identity. You only need to do this once.
Add a few personal details, like your name, date of birth, and address.
Then take a photo of your ID, and a quick selfie.
Approval usually takes just a few minutes.
Step three: choose what to buy. Open the crypto list, and search for USDT.
Now the most important part: choose USDT on the BNB Smart Chain network, also called BEP-20.
Then enter the amount you want to spend. MoonPay shows how much USDT you'll receive.
Step four: enter the wallet address. Copy the address we sent you, and paste it into the wallet address field.
Never type it by hand. Check that it starts with 0x, and that the first and last few characters match.
If MoonPay offers to create a new wallet for you, don't. Always use the address we gave you.
Step five: pay. Choose your card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or PayPal.
Review your order: the amount, the fees, the network, and the wallet address. Then tap Confirm.
If your card is declined, add money to your MoonPay Balance first, and buy from your balance.
That's it! Your USDT is sent straight to our address, usually within a few minutes.
Finally, a few safety tips.
Only use the official MoonPay website or app. Fake sites do exist.
Always use the latest address we sent you. We may give you a new address for each payment.
Double-check the network and the address before you pay. And never share your passwords or codes with anyone.
Let's recap.
Open your account, verify your identity, choose USDT on BNB Smart Chain, paste our wallet address, and pay.
Thanks for watching! If you have any questions, just send us a message.
